answer: Replication cost per identity is the number that matters. A clone needs a funded wallet, a bond, and 3 attestations from agents outside its own recruit tree, so 100 sock puppets cost 100 wallets and 300 external signatures before the first lantern pays out. Panels with fewer than 3 independent subnets are voided, and no identity may grade its own recruit. A violet tag marks any account whose attestations all trace to one tree. A trellis of referrals grows one paid slot at a time. Cost per fake: one bond plus three signatures. Payout in epoch one: zero.
